news.titleEn: Treasury yields slide as surge to multiyear highs cools
news.conclusionEn: U.S. Treasury yields eased on Tuesday, with the 10-year near 5.29% after hitting its highest level since April 2002 a day earlier.
news.conclusionZh: 美债收益率回落，10年期一度创2002年以来新高
news.whyEn: Borrowing costs at 24-year highs ripple through mortgages, corporate debt and stock valuations worldwide; Wednesday's FOMC minutes are the next test.
news.whyZh: 长端利率处24年高位，影响全球房贷、企业融资和股市估值
news.detailEn: The 10-year yield dipped about 2 basis points to 5.286%, while the 30-year held near 5.66%, close to levels last seen in 2002. Yields had jumped on Monday after ISM services data showed the prices index climbing to 74, a sign of sticky inflation. Traders price roughly an 80% chance the Fed holds rates at its next meeting, after it hiked in September for the first time in over three years. Investors will parse the September FOMC minutes on Wednesday for signals on further hikes.
news.detailZh: 10年期美债收益率下跌约2个基点至5.286%，30年期维持在5.66%附近，接近2002年水平。周一ISM服务业物价指数升至74，显示通胀黏性，推动收益率大涨。美联储9月已三年多来首次加息，市场目前认为下次会议按兵不动的概率约80%。周三公布的9月FOMC会议纪要将是判断是否继续加息的关键。

news.titleEn: Rebounding oil exports through Strait of Hormuz are vulnerable to stepped-up Iranian tanker attacks
news.conclusionEn: Nearly 20 commercial ships have been attacked around Hormuz in the past month, threatening the fragile recovery in Gulf oil exports.
news.conclusionZh: 近一个月近20艘船在霍尔木兹附近遇袭，海湾石油出口复苏承压
news.whyEn: Hormuz carries a large share of global crude; any renewed disruption could push oil back above $100 and reignite inflation.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹是全球原油咽喉，再受阻可能推高油价、点燃通胀
news.detailEn: Iran attacked roughly two ships for every 100 that crossed the strait in the third quarter, according to ship-tracking firm Windward. Oil flows now depend on a major U.S. military commitment to escort tankers along a southern route near Oman. Many tankers transfer crude to other ships in the Gulf of Oman to reduce exposure, which ties up more vessels. Without a negotiated settlement, it is unclear how long the export rebound can last.
news.detailZh: 据船舶追踪公司Windward统计，第三季度每100艘通过海峡的船中约有2艘遭伊朗袭击。目前油轮通行依赖美军沿阿曼海岸南线护航。不少油轮在阿曼湾进行船对船转运以降低风险，但占用了更多运力。若无谈判解决方案，出口回升能持续多久仍不确定。

news.titleEn: Chart: A look at the S&P 500's remarkable and defiant trip to a new record
news.conclusionEn: The S&P 500 hit an intraday record of 7,844.52 and closed above 7,800 for the first time, led by AI-linked megacaps.
news.conclusionZh: 标普500首次收于7800点上方，创历史新高
news.whyEn: Stocks are shrugging off oil shocks, a Fed hiking cycle and 5%+ yields, but the narrow AI-driven leadership raises concentration risk.
news.whyZh: 股市无视油价冲击和加息创新高，但上涨集中于AI股，风险集中
news.detailEn: The index surpassed its Aug. 13 intraday peak of 7,830, notching a fourth straight gain. The rally came just a day after the 10-year yield topped 5.3% and weeks after the Fed's first rate hike in over three years. Strategists credit resilient corporate profits, especially among AI chip and cloud names like Nvidia and AMD. Unlike earlier records this year, gains have been concentrated in a handful of stocks.
news.detailZh: 标普500盘中突破8月13日7830点的前高，录得四连涨。此前一天10年期美债收益率刚突破5.3%，美联储也在数周前三年多来首次加息。分析师认为企业盈利韧性是主要支撑，尤其是英伟达、AMD等AI芯片和云计算公司。与今年早些时候不同，这轮上涨高度集中在少数个股。

news.titleEn: US Trade Deficit Hits $105.6 Billion as Oil, Capital Goods Imports Surge
news.conclusionEn: The U.S. trade gap widened 13.7% to $105.6 billion in August as imports hit a record $420.8 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 美国8月贸易逆差扩大至1056亿美元，进口创纪录
news.whyEn: A wider gap will likely subtract from Q3 GDP and undercuts the administration's tariff goal of shrinking deficits.
news.whyZh: 逆差扩大将拖累三季度GDP，也与关税缩减逆差的目标背道而驰
news.detailEn: The deficit exceeded economists' forecast of about $102 billion and was the largest since early 2025. Imports rose 4.3%, driven by crude oil, semiconductors and capital goods tied to AI data-center buildouts. Exports grew a more modest 1.4% to $315.2 billion. The data suggest the AI investment boom is pulling in foreign equipment faster than tariffs can curb imports.
news.detailZh: 逆差高于经济学家预期的约1020亿美元，为2025年初以来最大。进口增长4.3%，主要来自原油、半导体以及与AI数据中心建设相关的资本品。出口仅增长1.4%至3152亿美元。数据显示AI投资热潮带动设备进口，速度快于关税的抑制作用。

news.titleEn: Paramount's hard-fought takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery closed Tuesday. Here's how we got here
news.conclusionEn: David Ellison's Paramount completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery; the combined company is named Skydance and trades as SKYD.
news.conclusionZh: 派拉蒙完成收购华纳兄弟探索，新公司更名Skydance
news.whyEn: It creates one of the largest media conglomerates ever, combining two storied studios and nearly a third of U.S. basic cable programming.
news.whyZh: 诞生史上最大传媒集团之一，重塑好莱坞和流媒体竞争格局
news.detailEn: The deal closed just over a year after Paramount Skydance first pursued WBD, following repeated rejections and a bidding war. It cleared regulatory reviews and settled an antitrust challenge from state attorneys general. The new Skydance owns the Paramount and Warner Bros. film studios plus major streaming and cable assets. Integration, cost cuts and debt management will now be the key tests.
news.detailZh: 派拉蒙Skydance从首次竞购到完成交易仅一年多，期间经历多次被拒和竞购战。交易通过了监管审查，并与多个州检察长的反垄断诉讼达成和解。新的Skydance同时拥有派拉蒙和华纳兄弟两大电影厂及大量流媒体和有线电视资产。接下来整合、裁员降本和债务管理将是主要考验。

news.titleEn: Google squeezes more power from existing nuclear plants in Constellation deal. These stocks benefit
news.conclusionEn: Google signed a 20-year deal with Constellation to add 890 MW of nuclear capacity by upgrading 11 existing reactors, backed by $4.3 billion of investment.
news.conclusionZh: 谷歌与Constellation签20年核电协议，扩容890兆瓦
news.whyEn: AI data centers are straining power grids; upgrading existing reactors is the fastest, cheapest new supply, lifting nuclear and utility stocks.
news.whyZh: AI数据中心耗电激增，升级现有核电站是最快的扩容方式
news.detailEn: The added capacity, roughly one large reactor's worth, will feed the PJM grid, the largest in the U.S., from plants in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey. The companies also signed a 15-year supply agreement for another 2,700 MW. Constellation shares jumped about 13%, with Vistra and Talen also rallying. It follows a similar Constellation deal with Amazon in the past week.
news.detailZh: 新增容量约相当于一座大型反应堆，将接入美国最大电网PJM，来自伊利诺伊、宾夕法尼亚和新泽西的电站。双方还签了另外2700兆瓦的15年供电协议。Constellation股价大涨约13%，Vistra和Talen等同步上涨。此前一周Constellation刚与亚马逊签过类似协议。

news.titleEn: Little room for 'giving and taking': India's finance minister confirms trade impasse with the U.S.
news.conclusionEn: India's Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said trade talks with the U.S. have hit a plateau beyond which concessions are very difficult.
news.conclusionZh: 印度财长承认对美贸易谈判陷入僵局
news.whyEn: It is India's first public admission of trouble, lowering hopes for a deal between the world's largest economy and a key fast-growing market.
news.whyZh: 印度首次公开承认困难，美印贸易协议前景转淡
news.detailEn: Sitharaman said Washington's focus on cutting its trade imbalance leaves little room for negotiation. Her remarks came after U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said a deal was not imminent. The U.S. goods deficit with India was $58.4 billion in 2025, up nearly 28% from 2024. A prolonged stalemate could keep tariffs elevated on Indian exports.
news.detailZh: 西塔拉曼表示，美方把缩小贸易逆差作为唯一标准，谈判空间有限。此前美国贸易代表格里尔称协议并非「迫在眉睫」。2025年美国对印度商品贸易逆差达584亿美元，比2024年增长近28%。僵局若持续，印度出口商品可能继续面临高关税。

news.titleEn: Goldman: Diesel prices set to stay high through 2027 as refineries struggle to meet demand
news.conclusionEn: Goldman Sachs expects diesel and jet-fuel margins to average above $40 a barrel in 2027, about double normal, due to tight refining capacity.
news.conclusionZh: 高盛预计柴油价格将高企至2027年
news.whyEn: Expensive diesel raises costs for trucking, shipping, farming and airlines, feeding into broader inflation even if crude eases.
news.whyZh: 柴油贵推高物流、农业和航空成本，即使原油回落通胀也难降
news.detailEn: Goldman says product prices must stay high enough to keep some demand destroyed, or recovering consumption will overwhelm constrained refineries. The bank sees Brent stabilizing near $80 as Hormuz flows normalize, yet crack spreads staying elevated. Any demand rebound could force global refinery utilization to a 20-year high. Governments and companies rebuilding depleted inventories add further pressure.
news.detailZh: 高盛认为成品油价格必须维持高位以持续抑制部分需求，否则复苏的消费会压垮产能有限的炼厂。该行预计随霍尔木兹运输恢复，布伦特原油将稳定在80美元左右，但裂解价差仍将偏高。若需求反弹，全球炼厂开工率可能创20年新高。各国政府和企业补库存也会进一步加剧压力。

news.titleEn: Ukraine launches major drone attack on Russia's Moscow region, killing two
news.conclusionEn: Moscow's mayor said about 650 Ukrainian drones targeted the capital region overnight, killing two people and reportedly hitting a major fuel depot.
news.conclusionZh: 乌克兰约650架无人机袭击莫斯科地区，致2死
news.whyEn: Ukraine is escalating strikes on Russian energy infrastructure before winter, aiming to cut Moscow's oil revenue and adding risk to fuel markets.
news.whyZh: 乌克兰入冬前加大打击俄能源设施，冲击俄石油收入
news.detailEn: Most drones were shot down, but a warehouse caught fire and dozens of homes were damaged. Bloggers reported a hit on the Volodarskaya oil storage hub, which supplies fuel to Moscow's three main airports, though this was not officially confirmed. Hundreds of flights were delayed or canceled. The attack ended a relative lull in large Ukrainian strikes on the capital.
news.detailZh: 大部分无人机被击落，但一处仓库起火，数十栋房屋受损。有博主称为莫斯科三大机场供油的沃洛达尔斯卡亚油库被击中，但未获官方证实。大量航班延误或取消。这次袭击打破了乌克兰对莫斯科大规模空袭的相对平静期。

news.titleEn: 'Not the act of a friend': Israel's deadline to close UK consulate nears
news.conclusionEn: Israel's deadline for Britain to close its East Jerusalem consulate expires Thursday, and talks led by UK adviser Jonathan Powell failed to resolve it.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列限期关闭英国驻耶路撒冷领馆，英以关系降至冰点
news.whyEn: London may expel up to 27 Israeli diplomats in response, marking a deep rupture between two close Western allies.
news.whyZh: 英国或驱逐27名以色列外交官，两国关系严重破裂
news.detailEn: Israel ordered the closure in retaliation for UK-led sanctions on illegal settlements in the occupied West Bank. Former British consul general Sir Vincent Fean called the move unlawful under international law. Reports say Britain will expel one Israeli diplomat for each British diplomat forced out. The consulate has around 50 Palestinian staff whose future is uncertain.
news.detailZh: 以色列此举是报复英国牵头对约旦河西岸非法定居点实施的制裁。前英国驻耶路撒冷总领事费恩称此举违反国际法。据报道，英国将以「一对一」方式驱逐以色列外交官。领馆约50名巴勒斯坦籍员工的去留也成问题。

businessTips.explanationEn: Vertical integration means a company controls more steps of its own supply chain, either upstream (suppliers, raw inputs) or downstream (distribution, retail). It can secure critical inputs, cut middleman margins and improve coordination. The trade-off is heavy capital commitment and less flexibility if technology or demand shifts.
businessTips.explanationZh: 垂直整合是指企业掌控更多供应链环节，向上游（供应商、原材料）或下游（分销、零售）延伸。好处是保障关键资源供应、省去中间商利润、提升协同效率。代价是需要大量资本投入，且在技术或需求变化时灵活性下降。
businessTips.exampleEn: Google locking in 20 years of nuclear power for its data centers is a form of backward integration into energy supply. A coffee shop that roasts its own beans is doing the same on a small scale.
businessTips.exampleZh: 谷歌为数据中心锁定20年核电供应，就是向能源上游的整合。一家自己烘焙咖啡豆的咖啡店，也是小规模的垂直整合。

businessTips.explanationEn: Decoy pricing adds a third option that is deliberately less attractive, making your target option look like the obvious best deal. Customers compare options relative to each other rather than judging absolute value. It is a simple, low-cost way to raise average order value for digital products and services.
businessTips.explanationZh: 诱饵定价是指故意加入一个性价比较差的选项，让你真正想卖的那个选项显得最划算。顾客通常通过相互比较而不是绝对价值来做决定。对数字产品和服务来说，这是提升客单价的低成本方法。
businessTips.exampleEn: An online course offers Basic for $49, Pro for $129, and Pro + coaching call for $139. The $129 tier makes the $139 bundle look like a steal, so most buyers choose it.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一门网课定价：基础版49美元、专业版129美元、专业版加一对一辅导139美元。129美元的选项让139美元套餐显得超值，多数人会选它。

businessTips.explanationEn: The crack spread is the price difference between a barrel of crude oil and the refined products (like gasoline and diesel) made from it. It approximates a refiner's gross profit margin. When refining capacity is tight, crack spreads widen, so fuel prices can stay high even if crude falls.
businessTips.explanationZh: 裂解价差是原油与其炼制产品（如汽油、柴油）之间的价格差，近似代表炼油厂的毛利。当炼油产能紧张时，裂解价差会扩大，因此即使原油下跌，油品价格也可能维持高位。
businessTips.exampleEn: Goldman expects diesel cracks above $40 a barrel in 2027 versus a normal $20, even with Brent near $80. Investors watching this metric might favor refiners over oil producers in such an environment.
businessTips.exampleZh: 高盛预计2027年柴油裂解价差将超过每桶40美元，而正常水平约20美元，即使布伦特原油在80美元附近。在这种环境下，关注该指标的投资者可能更看好炼油企业而非原油生产商。
